references.disposition: Direction reversal is the defining consequence of regarding F as an ordinary functor C^op→D, where the opposite-category and covariant-functor notions are already linked. Reversal of composition and identity preservation are inherited from the functor axioms; the source retains these facts.
Opposite-category formulation entails reversed composition and preservation of identities in the appropriate order.

references.context: Category theory: automorphism group Aut_C(x) of an object x, consisting of all invertible endomorphisms x→x with composition and identity; in a groupoid all arrows are invertible. This is distinct from a field-automorphism group or a subgroup of vertical automorphisms unless context requires it.
